verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Raygun exposes some API endpoints (Deployments API, source map upload API, external access token for various uploads) and an export feature, but there's no documented OpenAPI/spec (probes return 404) and no evidence that UI-only features like AI Resolution chat, error status/ignore rules, or dashboard filtering are exposed via API. missing for 10: comprehensive API reference/OpenAPI spec, API coverage for AI resolution and error-status workflows, independent confirmation of full UI-API parity.
